method: Direct public search inspection of ten accessible Kehot/Chabad.org item bodies. Eight records received bounded source-grounded propositions; two already-enriched records were inspected only for duplicate and continuity checks. The known blocked crawler was not used.

metric_delta.note: Net eligibility is +7 sources and +21 propositions after evidence-family dedup. The new Melbourne letter is linked to an already-counted family, and three overlapping proposition themes were not counted again.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: The new Yiddish letter is a distinct correspondence item but not independent confirmation of the school's finances, opening or outcomes; the Hebrew paraphrase is derived from the same witness.
Hebrew research paraphrases derive from the one Yiddish item and are not a translation witness.
Two distinct dated letters to Dr. A. Hillman are linked for continuity but retain separate evidence families; neither is treated as a duplicate manifestation of the other.

blocked_alternatives.result: Browser and open views returned publisher chrome only, with no letter body.
blocked_alternatives.fallback: Switched to other authorized publisher items whose bodies were publicly accessible in the same run.

blocked_alternatives.source: scripts/acquire_source_content.py and the previously blocked GitHub-hosted route
blocked_alternatives.result: Not retried; the known HTTP 403 route remained outside this run.
blocked_alternatives.fallback: Used public search/open access to authorized publisher bodies.

verification_scope: Ten publisher bodies were inspected. Eight were materially enriched; two were used for duplicate and continuity review. Incoming correspondence, archival originals, cited books, institutional records, health outcomes and practical halachic rulings were not independently verified.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and precise item/section locators were stored; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All added propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Yiddish-to-Hebrew paraphrases are marked derived, the partial public extract is scoped explicitly, health statements are not treated as medical evidence, and halachic discussions are not individualized rulings.
